async def act(page):
    # Fill in the product name
    await page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('group').get_by_role('textbox', name='[STORE VIEW] Product Name *').fill('Energy-Bulk Women Shirt')
    # Fill in the SKU
    await page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('group').get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] SKU *').fill('energy-bulk-women-shirt')
    # Fill in the price
    await page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('group').get_by_role('group').get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] Price * $').fill('60')
    # Fill in the quantity
    await page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('group').get_by_role('group').get_by_role('textbox', name='[GLOBAL] Quantity').fill('50')
    # Click the Save button to create the product
    await page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('button', name='Save').click()
